description: Mixes every channel of a polyphonic cable down to one monophonic signal

params.text: Attenuates the summed output; mixing a four-voice signal can raise the peak level fourfold, so about 25% is a reasonable starting point

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal to be mixed; the two-digit readout shows how many channels it carries

outputs.text: The channels added together as one signal

notes: the meter above the knob shows the level of the output, with marks at 0dB, -3dB, -6dB, -12dB, -24dB and -36dB
